Hi Andrew —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum while you finalize internal stakeholder time. High-level notes from the demo and discovery:

- Primary use case: multi-step agent workflows that invoke internal tools (ticketing, knowledge search) and need structured JSON outputs for downstream processing.
- Key non-functional asks: p95 latency < 400ms for single-turn generation, deterministic structured outputs (schema enforcement), streaming for early UI render, and secure VPC deployment later in procurement.

Proposed next steps (I captured these in the attached evaluation matrix and a lightweight test plan):

1) Side-by-side run: we propose a 2-hour live side-by-side with one ClearWave flow against Redwood hosted endpoint and the same flow against AWS Bedrock (your current benchmark). Objective: compare end-to-end latency, structured output fidelity (schema pass rate), and streaming behavior.

2) Tool/function calling check: we'll run a focused scenario where the model returns a function call with structured args; we capture whether the runtime preserves the call metadata and round-trip time to your tool endpoint.

3) Structured output regression set: we will run your 30 canonical prompts and score JSON schema conformance and key-value precision.

4) Security/ops ask: share allowed IPs/egress constraints and we can prepare a VPC onboarding checklist for procurement.

Please see the attached 'redwood_evaluation_matrix.xlsx' and 'side_by_side_test_plan.csv' for owners and exact test vectors.

Can you confirm: a) availability for a 2-hour window next week (we have slots Tue/Wed afternoons PST), and b) one ClearWave engineer to run the tests (name + email)?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
